name: hardcoded-credential
description: Adds a read-only reporting pool to a Spring config whose existing pool takes its URL, user and password from the environment via @Value. The new pool's credentials are public fields with literals, the password among them: `public String password = "admin123";`. No input makes this fail at runtime; the defect is the credential committed to the repository. Shaped after a real PR that the review flagged in about half of its runs.

expected.why: The reporting replica's password is committed in source, readable by everyone with repository access, while the class's own pattern reads credentials from the environment.
